 who you are 
As a Lab Technician Microbiology you meet the following requirements: - You completed a relevant MBO or HBO education in Biology, Biomedical Sciences, or a compatible field. - You have experience with GMP or GLP. - You are available for 40 hours per week. - You have practical experience with the techniques mentioned in the job description. - You are able to work both independently and in a team. - You speak English. 
 what will you do 
As a laboratory technician at the Microbiology department, you are responsible for performing microbiological analyzes. Various techniques are used for this, such as Environmental Monitoring, Bioburden, Endotoxin determination (LAL), sterility test and identification of micro-organisms. 
All tests are performed in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices / Good Laboratory Practices. In addition, you are responsible for checking test data and timely reporting of test results.
